verdict.rationale: Weave documents its own programmatic evaluation framework, an imperative evaluation API with datasets and scorers, framed as measuring repeatable test cases and catching regressions before they reach users. That covers the 'run evals' and pre-deployment intent of the story. However, nothing documents a CI integration or a deployment gate based on eval results. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or a CLI eval runner), pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for gating deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Measure every improvement to your harnesses and models with confidence with a flexible imperative evaluation API. Weave provides powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions before they reach users
measure your LLM application’s performance against repeatable test cases, compare changes over time, and identify regressions
the core of the workflow is the _`Evaluation` object_, which defines: A `Dataset` or list of dictionaries for test examples. One or more scoring functions.
